title: land's per-repository evidence names the request's own merge, not an unrelated later merge, for a fast-forwarded or rebased request
goal: bl_land.merge_commit names the request's own merge (or the branch tip for a fast-forward) even when an unrelated merge landed on the default branch after it; found by the SP-dqkf3i42 review at _tools/bl_land.py:961-974 (rev-list --merges --ancestry-path --reverse tip..upstream takes the oldest merge descending from the tip, which for a fast-forwarded tip is any later merge)

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *a:s.run(['git','-C',t,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null',*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
def c(n):
 open(os.path.join(t,n),'w').write(n);g('add',n);g('commit','-qm',n)
g('init','-q','-b','main');c('a');g('checkout','-qb','f');c('b');tip=g('rev-parse','HEAD');g('checkout','-q','main');g('merge','-q','--ff-only','f')
g('checkout','-qb','h');c('c');g('checkout','-q','main');c('d');g('merge','-q','--no-ff','-m','m','h')
r=bl_land.merge_commit(t,tip,'main','1');print(r==tip);sys.exit(0 if r==tip else 1)
